newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nethold assets valued at over 10 bln ffr - report.
newsitem.headline: Nethold assets valued at over 10 bln ffr - report.

text.p: The total assets of pay television group Nethold are valued between 10.725 billion and 12.175 billion francs, according to a report by merger partner Canal Plus.
The television assets of Nethold, controlled by Richemont and MIH Holdings, are valued at between 8.9 billion and 10.35 billion francs, or between 7,725 and 8,984 francs per subscriber.
The report, of which Reuters obtained a copy, was prepared for the annual general meeting of Canal Plus due on March 28.
The report said that the assets of Italian pay-television group Telepiu, in which Nethold has a stake, are valued at $2.0 billion.
Canal Plus will issue 6,142,532 new shares of 20 francs nominal to Nethold. The merger is set to become effective April 15.
